newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins FIM 140 mln GSM expansion.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins FIM 140 mln GSM expansion.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said on Monday it had won a 140 million markka GSM network expansion order from Singapore-based mobile phone operator Mobile One.
"Nokia has won a GSM network expansion order to Singapore ... worth about 140 million markka or 40 million Singapore dollars," a Nokia spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.
The expansion will make it possible for MobileOne to accommodate around 120,000 customers, Nokia said, adding it would remain the sole supplier of the MobileOne network.
MobileOne, Singapore's newest mobile and paging service provider, had gained a 10 percent market share "within the first weeks of operation", Nokia said.
MobileOne is owned by a consortium made up of the Keppel Group, Singapore Press Holdings, Cable and Wireless Plc and Hongkong Telecom, it said.
